## Overview

This report documents my three-month internship at Scigenix Pty (Ltd), a clinical research organization based in Pretoria, South Africa. The internship ran from **23 June 2025 to 30 September 2025** and provided invaluable practical experience in biostatistical consulting and collaboration.

### Report Structure

This internship report follows the structure outlined in the Portfolio of Evidence of Learning guidelines:

#### [1. Introduction & Background](introduction.qmd)

- General overview of Scigenix Pty (Ltd)
- My role and responsibilities
- Focus on collaboration and consultation activities

#### [2. Learning Objectives](learning-objectives.qmd)

- Matrix of learning outcomes and tasks
- Description of how each learning outcome was met
- Connection to module objectives

#### [3. Relation to Coursework](relation-to-coursework.qmd)

- How consulting work related to specific MSc Biostatistics modules
- Practical applications of theoretical knowledge
- Integration of statistical concepts across disciplines

#### [4. Work Outputs](work-outputs.qmd)

- **Consultation Projects**: Job Satisfaction Survey Analysis, Heart Murmur Recognition Study, Fresh Gas Flow Analysis
- **Clinical Research Activities**: Randomisation, Data Safety Committee, Quality Control, Annotated Case Report Forms, Manual Edit Checks, Shiny App Development
- Case reports of interesting consultations

#### [5. Reflection](reflection.qmd)

- What I learned and why it was significant
- What I would have done differently
- Challenges encountered and how I handled them
- Professional growth and development

---

## Key Takeaways

Through this internship, I gained hands-on experience in:

- Statistical consulting with multidisciplinary research teams
- Clinical trial design and implementation
- Data management and quality control processes
- Regulatory compliance in clinical research
- Software development for clinical data analysis
- Effective communication of statistical concepts to non-statistical audiences

This experience has profoundly shaped my understanding of the role of a biostatistician in modern clinical research and has prepared me for a successful career in this field.
